newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel plans to float Bezeq on Aug 31.
newsitem.headline: Israel plans to float Bezeq on Aug 31.

text.p: The Government Corporations Authority plans to hold a public share offering in Bezeq Israel Telecom on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on August 31, government sources said on Friday.
According to a working programme set up by a lawyer hired by the authority, it will present a prospectus for the offering to Bezeq's board of directors on July 8.
On July 10 the prospectus will be presented to the Securities Exchange Authority and it will be published on August 24.
August 31 is the last day to hold the offering based on Bezeq's first quarter results, released on Thursday.
The government plans to sell 24 percent of Bezeq, including about 10 percent in Tel Aviv.
Part of the issue will be offered to institutional investors in Israel and abroad but the timetable for this tranche has not been decided.

The Corporations Authority asked underwriters in Israel to submit offers to participate in the offering. It has also begun discussions with the Treasury's accountant general on how to divide the revenue from the offering.
